text: Rinsing doesn't wash germs away. It launches them.
Droplets can fly about two feet, onto your counter, towels, and food.
In a USDA study, sixty percent of people who rinsed chicken had germs in their sink.
Vinegar or lemon won't make it safe.
Only heat will: one hundred sixty-five degrees, inside the meat.
Do you wash yours? Send this to someone who still washes chicken.
